Tengo este archivo Python que escribí hace 6 meses y siento que está mal pero no sé exactamente qué. Revísalo y dime todos los problemas que tiene desde el punto de vista de principios SOLID, patrones de diseño y arquitectura:

```python
# order_processor.py
import smtplib
import psycopg2
import requests
import json
from datetime import datetime

DB_HOST = 'localhost'
DB_USER = 'admin'
DB_PASS = 'secret123'
SMTP_SERVER = 'smtp.gmail.com'
SMTP_PORT = 587
SMTP_USER = 'orders@myshop.com'
SMTP_PASS = 'emailpassword'
PAYMENT_API = 'https://api.payment.com/v1'
PAYMENT_KEY = 'pk_live_abc123xyz'

def process_order(order_data):
    # Connect to database
    conn = psycopg2.connect(host=DB_HOST, user=DB_USER, password=DB_PASS, database='orders')
    cur = conn.cursor()
    
    # Validate order
    if not order_data.get('customer_id'):
        return {'error': 'missing customer'}
    if not order_data.get('items'):
        return {'error': 'no items'}
    if order_data.get('total') <= 0:
        return {'error': 'invalid total'}
    
    # Check inventory
    for item in order_data['items']:
        cur.execute('SELECT stock FROM products WHERE id = %s', (item['product_id'],))
        row = cur.fetchone()
        if not row or row[0] < item['quantity']:
            return {'error': f'insufficient stock for {item["product_id"]}'}
    
    # Charge payment
    response = requests.post(
        f'{PAYMENT_API}/charge',
        headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {PAYMENT_KEY}'},
        json={'amount': order_data['total'], 'currency': 'USD', 'customer': order_data['customer_id']}
    )
    if response.status_code != 200:
        return {'error': 'payment failed'}
    
    payment_data = response.json()
    
    # Save order to DB
    cur.execute(
        'INSERT INTO orders (customer_id, total, status, payment_id, created_at) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s) RETURNING id',
        (order_data['customer_id'], order_data['total'], 'pending', payment_data['id'], datetime.now())
    )
    order_id = cur.fetchone()[0]
    
    for item in order_data['items']:
        cur.execute(
            'INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, quantity, price) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s)',
            (order_id, item['product_id'], item['quantity'], item['price'])
        )
        cur.execute('UPDATE products SET stock = stock - %s WHERE id = %s', (item['quantity'], item['product_id']))
    
    conn.commit()
    
    # Send confirmation email
    server = smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_SERVER, SMTP_PORT)
    server.starttls()
    server.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS)
    message = f'Subject: Order Confirmed\n\nYour order #{order_id} has been confirmed. Total: ${order_data["total"]}'
    
    cur.execute('SELECT email FROM customers WHERE id = %s', (order_data['customer_id'],))
    customer_email = cur.fetchone()[0]
    server.sendmail(SMTP_USER, customer_email, message)
    server.quit()
    
    # Update inventory report
    with open('inventory_log.txt', 'a') as f:
        for item in order_data['items']:
            f.write(f'{datetime.now()} - Sold {item["quantity"]} of product {item["product_id"]}\n')
    
    cur.close()
    conn.close()
    
    return {'success': True, 'order_id': order_id, 'payment_id': payment_data['id']}
```

El reporte debe ser priorizado y tener plan de acción.
